# JSON for Modern C++

This directory vendors the unmodified nlohmann/json **v3.12.0** single header and
its MIT license. The local compiler copies the header into the isolated temporary
workspace so C++ practice can use `#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>` without installing
or downloading a dependency during a code run.

- Release: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0
- Header: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/LICENSE.MIT
- `json.hpp` SHA-256, verified against the upstream release:
  `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`
